Heavy rain disrupts Gurugram; waterlogging, traffic issues reported

Heavy rainfall in Gurugram caused significant waterlogging and traffic disruptions on August 6, 2026. Vehicles were stranded in flooded streets, requiring cranes for removal. In response to the severe weather, Gurugram Police advised corporate offices and private establishments to implement work-from-home policies for their employees. The city's infrastructure struggled to cope with the downpour, leading to widespread inconvenience.
